thread:
maya_support: Heads up — customer acme corp (acct 012345) reports AWS Marketplace accelerator credit shows on the invoice PDF but their Console credits page reads $0. They purchased via order awsmkt-0a1b2c3d. Can billing/integrations take a look? @li_billing @sam_engineer
sam_engineer: Thanks — any confirmation the marketplace webhook reached our entitlement endpoint? Can you paste the marketplace order id + payload? :eyes:
maya_support: Order ID: awsmkt-0a1b2c3d. Invoice has a -$10,000 line with SKU 'accelerator-annual-50k' but dashboard balance is 0. Inbound webhook log shows 200 OK to /webhooks/marketplace at 2026-03-12T14:23Z. Payload snippet:
```
{"orderId":"awsmkt-0a1b2c3d","sku":"accelerator-annual-50k","entitlementId":"ent-7f2"}
```
ledger-bot: ledger-bot: Created ledger credit ledg_98765 for account 012345 for amount 1000000 cents (posted).
li_billing: Huh — ledger shows posted, but our console balance aggregator may have missed mapping to the subaccount. Is this an org subaccount? @jon_partner
maya_support: Yes — subacct 012345 under org-77. They migrated billing to consolidated billing on 2026-02-28.
jon_partner: Possible root cause: marketplace entitlement may have been associated with the root org instead of the subaccount during entitlement mapping after migration. Can someone check the entitlement->account mapping for ent-7f2 and the reconciliation job run at 2026-03-12T14:25Z?
sam_engineer: I'll grep the kafka topic and check the mapping table. Quick repro commands I ran:
```
# kafka-console-consumer --topic marketplace.entitlement --from-beginning --offset 12345 --max-messages 50 | jq .payload
# redis-cli GET acct:012345:credits
# tail -n 200 /var/log/credits/agg-20260312.log | sed -n '1,120p'
```
maya_support: Uploaded invoice + console screenshot to the ticket: https://redwood.support/t/INC-9876/screenshots. Customer needs credits applied before their Dedicated reservation next week.
li_billing: I'm seeing the ledger row ledg_98765 but the apply_to field is null — that prevents the aggregator from counting it toward acct 012345. Re-running the entitlement->ledger join job now.
ledger-bot: ledger-bot: Reconciler job started for ent-7f2 (run id reconciler-20260312-2).
jon_partner: If the reconcile doesn't set apply_to, we'll need a one-off backfill to set apply_to=012345 on ledg_98765. Need finance approval for the manual write. @elaine_finance
elaine_finance: Approve one-off backfill for this single ledger entry. Please include audit log and ticket reference in the change. :white_check_mark:
sam_engineer: Reconciler finished — it updated apply_to on ledg_98765 and emitted account.credit.updated event. I also triggered cache invalidation for acct 012345.
maya_support: Customer just confirmed in ticket that Console now shows $10,000 and they can create the reservation. Closing the loop — thanks everyone! :tada:
